resolved.description: The exact catalogue name, set only when the query matched exactly one weapon. Empty otherwise — never a guess picked from several candidates.

weapon_class.description: The resolved weapon's class. Empty when nothing resolved.

match_count.description: How many weapons the query matched, before any truncation.

candidates.description: Matched weapons in name order, at most 20. Ask the user which one they meant; do not choose.

candidates_truncated.description: True when match_count exceeds the listed candidates.

ambiguous.description: True when more than one weapon matched, and no answer about a single weapon can follow.

catalog_size.description: How many weapons were searched, after any weapon_class filter.

infusable.description: Whether this weapon accepts affinities. False means Standard is the only legal affinity for it.

max_upgrade.description: The highest upgrade level this weapon has: 25 for smithing-stone weapons, 10 for somber, 0 for weapons that cannot be reinforced. Pass this bound to attack-power; it cannot check it itself.

affinity_asked.description: The affinity the buff list was worked out for.

buffable.description: Whether anything at all can be put on this weapon at that affinity. False for most unique weapons, which is a real answer to 'is there a way to make it proc bleed'.

reason.description: Why not, when it does not: wrong class, wrong affinity, or the weapon cannot be buffed. Three different answers to the same question.

ignores_enhance.description: True for the skills — Seppuku, the mists — which work on weapons that refuse greases.

status_buffs.description: Every grease and armament buff, with whether it applies here.

try_next.description: On a miss, the node to try instead and what to read from it. Empty when the weapon resolved.
